← FolioCove tools

Tester guide & public launch gates

Status: NOT ready for public launch. A focused local audit on 2 October 2026 exercised all 88 catalog tools: 75 created structurally parseable downloads, 10 displayed reports or previews, and 3 reported expected limitations. This does not prove accuracy for every document. A working public support email, finished public notices and real-device pilot remain pending.

Small pilot

The owner should select a small group of consenting testers and grant access. No invitations have been sent. Cover desktop Chrome, Edge, Safari, Android Chrome and iOS Safari. Use synthetic files only.

Invitation text

Would you test FolioCove with a non-sensitive document? Try one task without help and inspect the downloaded result. Tell us whether you completed it successfully, without sending the document or its contents. This is a private beta; ask the owner for access.

Ten core tasks

  1. Merge two files and confirm page order.
  2. Extract pages 2–3.
  3. Move, rotate and remove pages visually.
  4. Compress to 500 KB; inspect readability and size.
  5. Convert two photos to PDF.
  6. OCR a sample scan and search for known text.
  7. Add text on page 2.
  8. Add a typed signature.
  9. Redact synthetic text; check visually and with independent extraction.
  10. Inspect metadata and confirm no sanitized sharing copy is created.

Suggested fixtures

Use a one-page PDF, five-page PDF, mixed sizes, rotated pages, scan, form, Unicode text, image-heavy file, password-protected file and malformed/truncated file. Unsupported files should produce a clear error, not a misleading download. Use equivalent photos, damaged images and wrong types for camera scanning.

Results

Download the blank results template. Record tool, browser, fixture type, completion, output correctness, help needed and sanitized issue category. Processing completion is not proof of task success.

Release gates

  • Run the existing ten-tool browser suite and focused corrupted-file, output, redaction and privacy checks. The expanded 100-case plan is deferred.
  • Collect feedback from a small pilot and inspect outputs. Real mobile, Safari and camera checks remain pending until performed.
  • Resolve critical output, data-loss, redaction and privacy defects.
  • Complete the network inspection and dependency review.
  • Supply operator details and review privacy/terms.
  • Choose a consent approach and architecture before adding remote analytics.
  • Owner approves public access; only then remove noindex and add a public sitemap.
